name: gobuster
description:
Directory/file & DNS busting tool written in GoGobuster is a tool used to brute-force: URIs (directories and files) in
web sites, DNS subdomains (with wildcard support), Virtual Host names
on target web servers, Open Amazon S3 buckets, Open Google Cloud buckets
and TFTP servers.

defaulteverythinglarge
Directory/file & DNS busting tool written in GoGobuster is a tool used to brute-force: URIs (directories and files) in
web sites, DNS subdomains (with wildcard support), Virtual Host names
on target web servers, Open Amazon S3 buckets, Open Google Cloud buckets
and TFTP servers.
Gobuster is useful for pentesters, ethical hackers and forensics experts.
It also can be used for security tests.
Installed size:9.16 MBHow to install:sudo apt install gobuster
